correctness.rationale: The object is exactly the simplicial family of all cyclic 0/1 words without four successive ones, including wrap-around. For r^a each orbit is a congruence class modulo d=gcd(n,a), and a fixed face contributes (-1)^{h-1} when h vertex-orbits are included, since the restricted permutation sign cancels their lengths. The weighted 4x4 transfer matrix has characteristic polynomial (x^5+1)/(x+1), and direct multiplication gives T^5=-I; periodic state paths reproduce the signed admissible word sum even for d=1,2,3 (all-ones periodic loops excluded). Folding reflections yields the 3/2, 3/3 and 2/2 end-run restrictions and the 10-step antiperiodic recurrence. Taylan Theorem 5.2 and Deshpande–Singh Theorem 4.6 supply concentration in degree q(n), rank 4 at multiples of 5 and rank 1 otherwise. Averaging character traces over 2n, with reduced cohomology understood, produces the four congruence classes. Independently enumerated admissible faces for n=12..16 and computed signed simplicial Lefschetz for every element; each matches formula. Finite tests corroborate the uniform matrix/fold proof rather than proving infinity.
